notes: Interactive Windows validation. Portable range semantics are automated separately.

cases.expect: Editor is announced as a code editor/document and document text can be read.
Caret and selection changes are announced without polling.
Visible ranges track scrolling and wrapped lines.
Screen points map to UTF-16 text ranges using rendered geometry.
A range returns one clipped screen rectangle per visible visual line.
Active composition and conversion target are exposed through TextEdit.
High contrast rendering retains the same UIA text document and selection semantics.
All localized sample/accessibility surfaces expand while format placeholders remain intact.
